pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients and distinct angular vertices. Large spatial area on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the lower limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with some narrowing observed on the lower limb sections.
